resources.string: Read-only comparison with the original navigation compass. Does not change CarPlay. Ages measure receipt time; values older than 3 seconds are stale. GPS direction can be unreliable when stopped.
Navigation service unavailable. Stop and retry.
Use original DR location and heading (experimental)

Prefers original AMap matched position and vehicle heading, even without GPS. Assumes GCJ-02 and converts to WGS84 for trial; accuracy is unverified. Needs location sharing. After 1.5 s without callbacks, falls back to the normal source. Receipt freshness does not prove a new measurement. Next connection.
